name: curtain-opacity
description: Verify the curtain opacity / light-blocking axis: sheer (translucent), light-filtering, room-darkening, blackout — rendered side by side. Sheer should be see-through; blackout fully opaque.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: place-opacity-row
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>/living|dining/i.test(x.id))||s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx=r.origin[0]+r.width/2, cz=r.origin[1]+r.depth/2; const levels=['sheer','light','room','blackout']; const items=levels.map((lb,i)=>({id:'c-'+lb,defId:'curtains',position:[cx-2.4+i*1.6,cz],rotation:0,props:{width:1.4,height:2.6,drawAmount:1,material:'cotton',lightBlock:lb,color:'#6f5aa8'}})); s.setItems(items); window.__row={cx,cz}; })()
